# Pomme Notes

Pomme Notes aims to make Obsidian feel native on macOS and iOS through a Liquid Glass aesthetic of frosted translucent overlays, softened contrast and gentle animations. Obsidian's familiar layout is preserved, and the recorded description names improvements to readability, mobile touch targets and plugin-specific styling.

![Pomme Notes screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mrparalloid/pomme-notes/HEAD/images/screenshot.jpg)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Pomme Notes"
    author: "mrparalloid"
    repo:   "mrparalloid/pomme-notes"
    slug:   "pomme-notes"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/pomme-notes"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/mrparalloid/pomme-notes"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mrparalloid/pomme-notes/HEAD/images/screenshot.jpg"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Make Obsidian feel native on macOS and iOS with a subtle Liquid Glass aesthetic that adds frosted translucent overlays, softened contrast, and gentle animations. Preserve Obsidian’s familiar layout while improving readability, mobile touch targets, and plugin-specific styling."
}
```
